about: ZONE-ENTRY ZE4: the wire bytes (the page host's Brotli) the whole shared grid strip block set may take: every seam source's road, baked once as blocks every home shares (src/scripts/bake-grid-seams.mjs, src/cook/game/gridStripPages.ts). The bake refuses a set over perHome times the distinct homes it bakes (gridStripSetBudget): 148000 is the old 3.7 MB set over the pinned 25 homes, and preview's borrowed staging cells (SA35) each bring their own road. Every home reads the whole set (its ring, then its outer road), so it is phone bytes: 4.0 MB at staging's 30 homes, inside PAGE-SIZE/SHARD-SIZE's 60 MB phone first-download ceiling. It replaced the per-shard rooms that let only four homes ship their road. 2026-11-23 (opus-compat-w7, J439/J444 declared raise): FORMAT-PRUNE FP29 took Ink Cel Valley and Pastel Plain off the pinned grid; they were 2 of 24 homes but carried almost no road (the set fell ~2%), so the per-home room fell 296000 while the set stayed 3.39 MB on CI. perHome 148000 -> 162000: 22 homes give 3564000, 5% over the measured 3392027 and just above the old 24-home 3552000.
